image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a bagel sandwich on a white plate. The bagel is sliced horizontally, with the top half resting on fillings including dark leafy greens (spinach or kale) and red tomato slices. The bottom half is visible beneath. To the right is a small glass bowl containing olive oil with herbs. On the left is a pink, translucent object that appears to be a stylized napkin or packaging with faint text-like markings. The background includes a crumpled white cloth.
